news.title: Aegis Logistics shares rally 4% as Q4 profit rises 45% YoY; Board recommends dividend
news.summary: Aegis Logistics shares rose sharply after the company reported a 45% year-on-year rise in Q4 FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 413 crore, supported by strong revenue growth. The board also recommended a final dividend of Rs 6.70 per share, boosting investor sentiment amid robust annual performance.

news.title: Zee Entertainment shares surge 20% in 5 days. What's behind the rally?
news.summary: Zee Entertainment shares rallied 20% over the past five trading sessions, hitting a nearly six-month high and adding more than Rs 1,660 crore to the company's market value. The surge has been driven by expectations that Zee could secure the India media rights for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
